Signed-off-by: jyz0309 <45495947@qq.com>

<!-- Thank you for contributing to TiDB!

PR Title Format:
1. pkg [, pkg2, pkg3]: what's changed
2. *: what's changed

-->

### What problem does this PR solve?

Issue Number: close #20464 <!-- REMOVE this line if no issue to close -->

Problem Summary:
Currently, the runtime stats of IndexMergeReaderExecutor is hard to understand, so we need to add some runtime information for it.

### What is changed and how it works?
What's Changed:
1.IndexMergeReaderExecutor uses IndexScan to read first, and got the handle value from index value, then use TableRowIDScan to read data. So,this pr add the information such as below:
- RPC runtime stats of TableScan
- RPC runtime stats of IndexScan
- RPC runtime stats of TableRowIDScan

How it Works:
before this pr:
```
mysql> explain analyze select /*+ use_index_merge(t1, primary, t1a) */ * from t1 where id < 2 or a > 4;
+-------------------------------+---------+---------+-----------+------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------+--------+------+
| id                            | estRows | actRows | task      | access object          | execution info                                                                                                                           | operator info                                  | memory | disk |
+-------------------------------+---------+---------+-----------+------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------+--------+------+
| IndexMerge_8                  | 3334.67 | 2       | root      |                        | time:1.241177ms, loops:2, cop_task: {num: 1, max:471.759µs, proc_keys: 1, rpc_num: 1, rpc_time: 444.307µs, copr_cache_hit_ratio: 0.00}   |                                                | N/A    | N/A  |
| ├─TableRangeScan_5(Build)     | 3333.33 | 0       | cop[tikv] | table:t1               | time:0ns, loops:0                                                                                                                        | range:[-inf,2), keep order:false, stats:pseudo | N/A    | N/A  |
| ├─IndexRangeScan_6(Build)     | 3333.33 | 1       | cop[tikv] | table:t1, index:t1a(a) | time:0ns, loops:0, tikv_task:{time:0s, loops:1}                                                                                          | range:(4,+inf], keep order:false, stats:pseudo | N/A    | N/A  |
| └─TableRowIDScan_7(Probe)     | 3334.67 | 0       | cop[tikv] | table:t1               | time:0ns, loops:0                                                                                                                        | keep order:false, stats:pseudo                 | N/A    | N/A  |
+-------------------------------+---------+---------+-----------+------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------+--------+------+
4 rows in set (0.00 sec)
```
after this pr:
```
mysql> explain analyze select /*+ use_index_merge(t2, primary, t2a) */ * from t2 where id < 2 or a > 4;
+-------------------------------+---------+---------+-----------+------------------------+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------+-----------+------+
| id                            | estRows | actRows | task      | access object          | execution info                                                                                                                                                                | operator info                                  | memory    | disk |
+-------------------------------+---------+---------+-----------+------------------------+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------+-----------+------+
| IndexMerge_8                  | 3334.67 | 2       | root      |                        | time:1.209156ms, loops:2, index_task:{scan:223.583µs, merge:11.276µs}, table_task:{num:2, concurrency:5, time:3.533454ms}                                                     |                                                | N/A       | N/A  |
| ├─TableRangeScan_5(Build)     | 3333.33 | 0       | cop[tikv] | table:t2               | time:257.067µs, loops:1, cop_task: {num: 1, max:172.939µs, proc_keys: 0, rpc_num: 1, rpc_time: 117.418µs, copr_cache_hit_ratio: 0.00}                                         | range:[-inf,2), keep order:false, stats:pseudo | 147 Bytes | N/A  |
| ├─IndexRangeScan_6(Build)     | 3333.33 | 0       | cop[tikv] | table:t2, index:t2a(a) | time:224.996µs, loops:1, cop_task: {num: 1, max:245.798µs, proc_keys: 0, rpc_num: 1, rpc_time: 152.734µs, copr_cache_hit_ratio: 0.00}                                         | range:(4,+inf], keep order:false, stats:pseudo | N/A       | N/A  |
| └─TableRowIDScan_7(Probe)     | 3334.67 | 2       | cop[tikv] | table:t2               | time:599.458µs, loops:4, cop_task: {num: 2, max: 272.869µs, min: 129.393µs, avg: 201.131µs, p95: 272.869µs, rpc_num: 2, rpc_time: 273.09µs, copr_cache_hit_ratio: 0.00}       | keep order:false, stats:pseudo                 | N/A       | N/A  |
+-------------------------------+---------+---------+-----------+------------------------+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------+-----------+------+
4 rows in set (0.00 sec)
```

issue_context.title: refine IndexMergeReaderExecutor runtime stats
issue_context.body:
## Development Task
Currently, the runtime stats of IndexMergeReaderExecutor is hard to understand, here is an example:
```
mysql> explain analyze select /*+ use_index_merge(t1,a,b) */ * from t1 where b > 2 or a > 4;
+---------------------------------+---------+---------+-----------+----------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------+----------------+------+
| id                              | estRows | actRows | task      | access object        | execution info                                                                                                                                                                                                                               | operator info                    | memory         | disk |
+---------------------------------+---------+---------+-----------+----------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------+----------------+------+
| Projection_4                    | 5555.56 | 10000   | root      |                      | time:27.549099ms, loops:11, Concurrency:5                                                                                                                                                                                                    | test.t1.a, test.t1.b             | 151.3515625 KB | N/A  |
| └─IndexMerge_8                  | 5555.56 | 10000   | root      |                      | time:27.488775ms, loops:11, cop_task: {num: 2, max: 7.432694ms, min: 7.421447ms, avg: 7.42707ms, p95: 7.432694ms, max_proc_keys: 10000, p95_proc_keys: 10000, tot_proc: 12ms, rpc_num: 2, rpc_time: 14.783365ms, copr_cache_hit_ratio: 0.00} |                                  | N/A            | N/A  |
|   ├─IndexRangeScan_5(Build)     | 3333.33 | 10000   | cop[tikv] | table:t1, index:b(b) | time:0ns, loops:0, tikv_task:{time:6ms, loops:14}                                                                                                                                                                                            | range:(2,+inf], keep order:false | N/A            | N/A  |
|   ├─IndexRangeScan_6(Build)     | 3333.33 | 10000   | cop[tikv] | table:t1, index:a(a) | time:0ns, loops:0, tikv_task:{time:6ms, loops:14}                                                                                                                                                                                            | range:(4,+inf], keep order:false | N/A            | N/A  |
|   └─TableRowIDScan_7(Probe)     | 5555.56 | 0       | cop[tikv] | table:t1             | time:0ns, loops:0                                                                                                                                                                                                                            | keep order:false                 | N/A            | N/A  |
+---------------------------------+---------+---------+-----------+----------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------+----------------+------+
5 rows in set (0.02 sec)
```
there is some problem:
1.IndexMergeReaderExecutor uses IndexScan to read first, and got the handle value from index value, then use TableRowIDScan to read data. So, we need to know the information such as below:
- RPC runtime stats of TableScan
- RPC runtime stats of IndexScan
- RPC runtime stats of TableRowIDScan
## Describe the feature you'd like:
Here is an example of IndexMergeReaderExecutor runtime stats:
```
time:1.350364ms, loops:2, index_task: {num: 1, time: 10ms, rpc_num: 2, rpc_time: 8ms}, table_task: {num: 503, time: 290ms, rpc_num: 509, rpc_time: 8ms}, cop_task: {num: 1, max:510.216µs, proc_keys: 1, rpc_num: 1, rpc_time: 455.08µs, copr_cache_hit_ratio: 0.00}
```
also, we'd better separate the coptask information to the build and probe side of IndexMergeReaderExecutor. That would reduce the length of execution info of IndexMergeReaderExecutor

review_comments: Should we record this information for each partial worker so that we can know which one is the bottleneck, which may be useful?
If we want to know which partial worker is the bottleneck, maybe we can record the max time to find it?

No need to record each partition worker stats, since it already exists.

```sql
 IndexMerge_8                  | 3334.67 | 2       | root      |                        | time:1.209156ms, loops:2, index_task:{scan:223.583µs, merge:11.276µs}, table_task:{num:2, concurrency:5, time:3.533454ms}             
 ├─TableRangeScan_5(Build)     | 3333.33 | 0       | cop[tikv] | table:t2               | time:257.067µs, loops:1, cop_task: {num: 1, max:172.939µs, proc_keys: 0, rpc_num: 1, rpc_time: 117.418µs, copr_cache_hit_ratio: 0.00} 
 ├─IndexRangeScan_6(Build)     | 3333.33 | 0       | cop[tikv] | table:t2, index:t2a(a) | time:224.996µs, loops:1, cop_task: {num: 1, max:245.798µs, proc_keys: 0, rpc_num: 1, rpc_time: 152.734µs, copr_cache_hit_ratio: 0.00} 
```

partitial worker of `TableRangeScan_5` and `IndexRangeScan_6` already has individual execution info.
